➡️ Join this channel to get access to member only perks:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCDJ2HAZ_hW-DMJj_U0zN38w/join

Chapters:
00:00 - Introduction
00:33 - Rate Limiter vs Bulkhead
02:41 - Semaphore Bulkhead Use-Case discussion
04:18 - Thread Pool Bulkhead Use-Case discussion
10:57 - Implementation of Semaphore Bulkhead
17:49 - Implementation of Thread Pool Bulkhead
26:29 - Testing the code flow with Output analsyis
30:40 - Use of completedFuture in critical section of Thread Pool Bulkhead
35:54 - What is Time Limiter and why we are not covering it
38:41 - closing notes

Pre-requisite topics:
Fault Tolerance (Part-1), RateLimiter: https://youtu.be/o9uCQHdh4DU
Semaphore lock: https://youtu.be/DPob5NLzKFI
Thread Pool and Executor: https://youtu.be/ZUWs2U71vvk
